paragraphs.text: The Iron Kingdom was an ancient war-empire on Corondor , founded by the ruthless warlord Mandek Ironfist . Mandek established his domain in the region of Golthonor , choosing the abandoned city of Gan as his capital after ordering the fallen angel Trine to annihilate its entire population of over 100,000 Ganarians. The city's empty streets and untouched buildings became the core of Mandek's new realm, which he renamed Ironhold — a symbol of his dominion and strength.

The Iron Kingdom's central seat, Ironhold, remained significant for centuries. 346 years after its founding, it was the site of the Absolution of Trine , when Trine's sister, the Serra Angel Rahel , ended Trine's tormented existence, absolving her of her ancient crimes. Despite the fierce battle between the angels, Ironhold itself suffered little damage and endured as a fortress city after Trine's death.
The exact fate of the Iron Kingdom after these events is unknown. Its location is thought to have been south of Wolf's Hackle , deep within Golthonor on ancient Corondor.
